title: Noether
caption: A simulation of elastic collisions between bodies.  It shows the conservation of momentum (linear and angular) and kinetic energy.  The viewer can see the exchange of momentum and energy between the bodies during collisions.  The conservation laws are direct consequences of Noether's theorem.  Uses a small bespoke physics engine.

title: Kaleidoscope 2
caption: A kaleidoscopic pattern generated by reflecting and rotating shapes.

title: Turners
caption: Lines drawn between three rotating points leading to a mandala-like patterns. Complementary colours.  The lines are drawn with a low opacity to create a sense of depth.

title: Qix
caption: Inspired by the 1981 arcade game Qix.  Curves drawn with bezierVertex.  Uses DFX library to apply a glow filter to the curves.  The statusbar library is used for simple controls and to allow switching between GPU and CPU rendering.
